compiled_state.description:
## Problem

The live prompt-eval loop in `.github/workflows/prompt-eval.yml` (`eval-live`) calls `rebar.llm.evals.eval.run_eval` on every dataset-bearing spec under `src/rebar/llm/eval_specs/`. Three of those specs have no solver, so every case is recorded as a run error and the spec reports coverage 0.00:

| spec | cases (at `REBAR_EVAL_MAX_CASES=12`, 3 epochs) | message |
|---|---|---|
| plan-review-container | 36 | `run error: no eval solver for prompt 'plan-review-container'` |
| plan-review-finder | 36 | `run error: no eval solver for prompt 'plan-review-finder'` |
| plan-review-isf-finder | 12 | `run error: no eval solver for prompt 'plan-review-isf-finder'` |

The error is raised at `src/rebar/llm/evals/eval_solver.py:423` after no prompt-id branch matches.

## Reproduction (measured 2026-11-09, origin/main 872e7f6c3fd)

Inside a local gate session (needed because of open bug `dissocial-unpleasant-adouri`), run `run_eval(pid, max_cases=12, repo_root=root)` for each of the three prompt ids with `AWS_PROFILE=frontier-bedrock`. Each JUnit file carries only the message above.

## Expected

Either each dataset-bearing spec resolves to a solver, or the loop skips specs that a different harness owns and says so, so a 0.00 coverage result means "scored nothing" only when something actually failed to score.

## Notes

Found while recording the before/after prompt evals for the model upgrade. Whether these specs are meant to be run by another harness (for example the criterion or replay harnesses) was not checked.
